project_boundaries.statement: Actual sphere inclusion derivative must have range exactly (ℝ∙x)ᗮ, hence every ambient tangent vector has a preimage. This surjectivity is essential for the unique-characterization direction. Its injectivity makes the pulled-back ambient pairing an inner product; use the actual map, never the default chart inner product. These are library proof dependencies, not public premises.
